i.norm: Decoding a ByteBuffer whose bytes are not valid hexadecimal characters must fail. A freshly allocated direct buffer is filled with zero bytes. Hex.decode(Object) routes a ByteBuffer to decode(ByteBuffer), which interprets each byte as a hex digit character. Since 0x00 is not a legal hex character, decoding throws a DecoderException: "Illegal hexadecimal character 0x00 at index 0."
Thrown by Hex.toDigit when it encounters the 0x00 byte.
